text: 有市场消息称，DeepSeek已委托中信证券筹备科创板IPO。从知情人士处获悉，该消息属实。目前，中信证券已与DeepSeek方面接洽并进入尽职调查阶段，但双方尚未签订正式的上市辅导协议。（21财经）
text_en: Market reports suggest DeepSeek has commissioned CITIC Securities to prepare for a STAR Market IPO. Sources with knowledge of the matter confirm this. CITIC Securities has engaged with DeepSeek and entered due diligence, though no formal listing advisory agreement has been signed. (21st Century Business Herald)
